day1.label: Speed
day1.base: Jog 1 mile + stretch for cool down after the workout. Includes 6 wickets after the sprint reps.

weeks.7: 3 x (3-4 Cross Fields) — sprint across field, walk/jog to sideline, 4' rest between sets
weeks.8: 3 x (3-4 Cross Fields) — sprint across field, walk/jog to sideline, 4' rest between sets
weeks.9: 3 x (3-4 Cross Fields) — sprint across field, walk/jog to sideline, 4' rest between sets
weeks.10: Taper: repeat Wk7-9 pattern at your discretion, prioritize freshness
weeks.11: Taper: repeat Wk7-9 pattern at your discretion, prioritize freshness

day1.tj: Full sprint volume is fine — this is direct speed work for your approach. Just don't stack a max-effort sprint day right before/after a heavy bounding day if you can help it; ankles and Achilles need the recovery gap.

day2.label: Circuits
day2.base: Complete a 20-30' run or machine interval before the circuits below. Includes an LJ/TJ warmup between the circuit and plyo work.

weeks.4: 2x General Circuit 4 @ 12-14 reps + 2x Bounding Series A @ 20"/40"
weeks.8: 2x GC4 + 1x GC1 @ 12-14 reps + 2x Bounding Series A @ 30"/30"
weeks.11: Light circuit of your choice — pre-season taper

day2.tj: When you're short on time, do the bounding/plyo block first and full-effort — that's the piece most specific to your event. The general circuits (GC1-4) are conditioning filler; trim reps there before you trim the plyo.

day3.label: Hills
day3.base: Run 1 mile cool down after the workout. Rest: walk/jog back each rep, 30-60", 5' between sets if applicable.

weeks.11: Taper: 2 x 4-5 Over 100m Hills, focus on drive phase

day3.tj: This is the highest-impact day on your joints of the whole week. If your legs feel beat up, cut volume ~20-25% here first — not on your plyo/bounding day. Worth a direct check-in with Coach Powell on hill volume given your event.

day5.label: Lunge
day5.base: Run 1 mile before the workout. Jog 1 mile cool down after.

weeks.8: 1x Circuit Warm Up B + Running Circuit
weeks.10: 1x Circuit Warm Up B + Vacation Circuit

day5.tj: Good day to add short approach pop-ups (3-5 step run-in → hop-step-jump) after the circuit if you have access to a pit or soft landing — keeps rhythm sharp without more high hill/plyo impact.

recovery.label: Recovery
recovery.text: 1-2x 20-30' easy recovery run. Use these days for you — mentally, physically, emotionally.
recovery.tj: Don't skip the ice baths (2x/week recommended) — triple jump landings add up fast over a week of hills + bounding. This is where you protect next week's training, not lose fitness.
